item.name: Verify all registrations and GET response

exec: pm.test('All 4 POST route variants registered a user', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const users=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(users).to.have.length(7); const emails=['postmanSignupUsers','postmanSignupUser','postmanUser','postmanUsers'].map(function(k){return pm.collectionVariables.get(k).toLowerCase();}); emails.forEach(function(email){pm.expect(users.some(function(user){return user.userEmail===email;}),email).to.eql(true);}); users.forEach(function(user){pm.expect(user).not.to.have.property('userPassword');}); });
